findings.element: Stock check block on Overview (State 3) and Stock check differences page (State 3)
findings.finding: When one store's nightly check failed, both surfaces still present an all-clear: the Overview block shows a check_circle "Stock is the same in QuickBooks and Shopify." directly under the failure, and the differences page shows only "No unresolved differences." with the failure buried in the grey "Latest comparison" meta line.
findings.user_impact: A user scanning for differences reads the green/empty result as "all stores match" and never re-runs the comparison for My good flowers, so its stock gaps stay open.
findings.suggested_fix: Scope the all-clear to the stores actually compared (e.g. "My ceramic plates: stock is the same") and, on the differences page, show the failed store as an error row or banner with Compare now instead of a plain "No unresolved differences."

evidence.action: Opened State 3 Overview, then the Stock check tab.
evidence.observed: Overview block: "error The last check of My good flowers failed (Oct 2, 2026 02:30)… Compare now · check_circle Stock is the same in QuickBooks and Shopify."; differences page: "Latest comparison · My ceramic plates: Oct 2, 2026 02:30 · My good flowers: failed Oct 2, 2026 02:30" above a table reading only "No unresolved differences."

findings.element: Onboarding steps vs "Setup needed" store card (same store-readiness steps)
findings.finding: The new V2 onboarding lists readiness as "1 Enable inventory tracking, 2 Choose location", while the same readiness appears on the Setup needed store card as "1 Choose location, 2 Set Created product to Inventory, 3 1 item needs mapping" — different order, different label for the same step, and an extra step.
findings.user_impact: A user who learned the 2-step setup on the first store meets a reordered, renamed 3-step list for the next store and has to re-work out whether these are the same requirements and whether mapping is now mandatory.
findings.suggested_fix: Use one ordered step list with the same labels in both the onboarding and the store card, and keep mapping visually separate from the required readiness steps.

evidence.action: Connected My ceramic plates and walked onboarding steps 1–2; then opened State 2 Overview where My good flowers is Setup needed.
evidence.observed: Onboarding: "1 Enable inventory tracking … Open Settings / 2 Choose location"; store card: "1 Choose location … 2 Set Created product to Inventory … Open Settings / 3 1 item needs mapping … Map products".

findings.element: Overview right after Finish setup (sync Disabled): Sync block Enable vs store card "Ready" + Map products
findings.finding: After onboarding, the only explicit pointer to the required next action (Enable) is a transient toast, while the wide store card says "Ready" and offers its own CTA "Map products" and nothing on the card says the store is not receiving changes yet (KF-2).
findings.user_impact: Once the toast fades, users read "Ready" as the job being done or follow the adjacent Map products CTA, and leave with sync still Disabled and no stock being sent.
findings.suggested_fix: Make the not-yet-sending state persistent on the page — e.g. the store card reads "Ready — turn on sync to start" with the Enable action, or the Sync block carries an inline prompt — rather than relying on the toast.

evidence.action: Chose a location and clicked Finish setup.
evidence.observed: Toast "My ceramic plates is ready. Click Enable to start sending stock changes."; page: tiles all "–", Sync "State: Disabled · Enable" in the narrow left column; store card "My ceramic plates (Shopify) · Ready · … 1 item needs mapping … Map products".

gaps: Onboarding step rows (KF-4): the map records no hover/cursor/click on the collapsed "2 Choose location" row or the done step-1 row, so whether numbered rows look clickable but are dead is unknown.
Visual weight of Enable vs Map products is not recorded (no button styles in the map), which limits confidence on UX-3.

Bulk Update Shopify qty with Unresolved only off: after confirming, the table read "No unresolved differences." — the map does not record whether the toggle was still off, so whether updated rows vanish from view entirely (no record of what was sent) is unknown.
Second-store path in V2: Connect store on a Not connected card after the first store is ready was not exercised, so it is unknown whether it reuses the 2-step onboarding or the card checklist.
Bulk actions across stores: only My ceramic plates had differences, so cross-store selection and the dialog wording for multiple stores were not exercised.
Compare now (Overview block and differences page) was not exercised; recovery from the failed nightly check is unverified.
Failed tile: no Failed sample events, so the Failed tile → Activity path and its state are unverified (known limitation).
